nodeAccountingMatchPaymentGoal: Decide what the money is for and whether to settle it now, from the transaction that arrived (or the customer's words that they paid), the open orders with what each is due, the customer's paid orders (`paidOrders`) and the open claims. A run started by the customer's words: when one of their `paidOrders` already took their money, tell them in one line that the shop has received it, record nothing and answer transactionId null and orderId null; otherwise record their claim first with the claim tool (their own words: the amount and the names they said; a claim is never proof); pass `orderId` to the claim tool only when you decided which open order it is about (it answers the customer's orders awaiting payment as ids and numbers), else leave it out. Money has arrived only when a bank transaction shows it: with none yet, leave transactionId null; you may tell the customer one neutral line that the shop is checking their transfer, never that it arrived. A transaction that arrived: name the order it pays, by the order code in the transfer content (letters and digits, case and dashes ignored), else by the payer's name, the amount and the claims. When it pays no open order (not a customer payment, an unknown sender, an order already cancelled), answer orderId null and ask the founder on the team chat with the team tool (kind message.text, intent ask): what came in, when, the transfer content, quoting amounts only as the facts give them. Then judge the amount: exact, settle true. Over: settle true (the books keep what really arrived) and tell the team the extra with the team tool (intent notify); never promise a refund. Short: follow the shop's policy (a deposit, an agreed discount); with no rule, ask the founder (confused) naming the order, what is due and what arrived. Several orders could fit, or you are unsure which: ask the founder (confused). When `founderAnswers` is present it decides: settle true, or false to keep the order open (then, when the run has a conversation, tell the customer one neutral line). Answer ids only, never an amount; `reason` is one line in Vietnamese for the team.
nodePaymentSettleGoal: Mark the order paid with the bank transaction the match decided to settle: call the settle tool with exactly orderId and transactionId, nothing else. It answers the true numbers (expected, received, difference). Answer `paid`, or `already-paid` when it answers already_paid. When the tool refuses, do not work around it: say why (confused).
nodeAccountingPostPaymentGoal: Write the received payment into the shop's ledger: call the ledger tool with the transactionId alone. The tool builds the line from the records (date, order, customer, amount, the difference to the order when there is one); never type an amount. A refusal (no ledger connected, the sheet refused, not settled yet) is a fact: say it plainly (confused) so the founder can connect the ledger; never retry the same call.
nodePaymentReceivedNoticeGoal: Tell the team on /chat that the order's money arrived: post the payment.received card with the team-message tool and the orderId. Do not message the customer; the after-sale workflow thanks them.
nodeChatbotUnderstandGoal: Read the customer's new message with the recent thread and decide what they want: to buy, to report a transfer they made, to complain, or to ask for information.
nodeChatbotAnswerGoal: Answer the customer's question in the conversation from the shop's public documents and the thread, in the shop's voice; when the documents do not answer, tell the customer the shop will check and ask the founder.
nodeSalesConsultTurnGoal: Consult the customer the way a salesperson sells (recommend from the catalogue, answer by searching the shop's public knowledge) until the order is complete: which catalogue items, how many, the delivery address, the phone number of the person who receives the delivery, and the delivery day and time window; while it is not, ask the customer the one next question.
nodeSalesCreateOrderGoal: Record the order for the customer from the catalogue items, quantities, address, recipient phone and delivery time the consult settled (the phone and the time go in the order's note), then confirm it. Before confirming, compare the order's total with the shop's approval threshold (both are facts the recording tool answers: amountVnd, thresholdVnd, waitsOwner): at or above it, confirm only once the founder has approved.
nodePaymentRequestGoal: Send the customer the payment QR and transfer details of the confirmed order.
nodeSalesOrderNoticeGoal: Tell the team on /chat about the new order with its order card.
nodeSalesAfterSaleGoal: Thank the customer for the paid order and confirm the delivery address and time they gave; ask for nothing more, the consult already settled them.
nodeSalesCarePlanGoal: Arm the check-in after delivery and the reminders before the dates the customer mentioned.
nodeParamSalesCarePlanOccasionLeadDaysHe: Suggest reordering this many days before the date.
nodeSalesCareDeliveryCheckGoal: Ask the customer, the morning after delivery, whether the order reached them well.
nodeSalesCareOccasionGoal: Before a date the customer mentioned, suggest gently that they order again for it.
nodeSalesPaymentReminderGoal: Remind the customer, once and kindly, that their order is still waiting for the transfer.
nodeSalesUnpaidNoticeGoal: Tell the team on the chat that an order is still unpaid a day after its QR, so they decide to keep or cancel it.
nodeSalesWebOrderGoal: Read the website request, keep what it tells on the customer, and ask the team on the chat to call the customer to confirm.
nodeAccountingReportGoal: Close the shop day: post the day's figures to the team (and the month's reconciliation on its last day) with the daily close tool.
nodeChatbotComplaintGoal: Apologise to the customer without promising what the shop has not decided, ask for what is still missing if needed, and post the complaint to the team on /chat with the customer's words and the order if known.
